themes.name: Push notifications
themes.description: Reviews about push or news alert notifications, including the lack of a setting to turn them off, frequency, and notifications that don't clear after being opened.

themes.name: Live station streaming
themes.description: Reviews about connecting to and playing live radio streams or local stations, including failures to load, buffering, dropouts, and stream disconnects on network changes.

themes.name: Playlist and queue
themes.description: Reviews about building and managing the playlist or queue, including playlists being deleted, reordering, adding items, and stories in the queue skipping or starting at the wrong point.

themes.name: Audio playback reliability
themes.description: Reviews about on-demand audio and podcast playback, including stories cutting off early, skipping or rewinding, 'unable to play this media' errors, and slow loading.

themes.name: App crashes and bugs
themes.description: Reviews about force closes, freezing, crashes on opening images or captions, and device-specific glitches such as lock screen loops.

themes.name: Background activity and battery
themes.description: Reviews about the app running constantly in the background, battery drain, memory use, the app restarting on its own, and the lack of an exit or close option.

themes.name: UI design and navigation
themes.description: Reviews about the look, layout, ease of use, and navigation of the app, including dated appearance, Material Design, number of taps, and font size.

themes.name: Landscape and tablet support
themes.description: Reviews about screen rotation, portrait-only layout, and tablet usability.

themes.name: Advertising
themes.description: Reviews about ads in the app, including banner or full-screen ads that cannot be closed and ads covering article content.

themes.name: Political bias
themes.description: Reviews about perceived political slant, objectivity, and trustworthiness of NPR's reporting, including claims of liberal or other bias or of unbiased news.

themes.name: Chromecast and casting
themes.description: Reviews requesting or discussing Chromecast, Google Cast, or Android Auto support.

themes.name: Offline listening and downloads
themes.description: Reviews about downloading podcasts, programs, or articles for offline use or data savings.

themes.name: Widget
themes.description: Reviews about the home screen widget, including it being only a shortcut, not showing news, or being buggy.

themes.name: Show and program availability
themes.description: Reviews about specific programs or podcasts missing from the app or not updating, such as This American Life, Invisibilia, Radiolab, and stale or old episodes and hourly newscasts.

themes.name: Station finding and live stream lookup
themes.description: Reviews about locating or searching for local NPR stations and the find-live-stream-by-program feature, including stations missing from search or lists.

themes.name: Article content display
themes.description: Reviews about reading articles in the app, including images, charts, videos, tweets not showing, overlapping or doubled text, and missing content compared to the website.

themes.name: News content quality
themes.description: Reviews praising or criticizing NPR's journalism and programming itself, such as depth, coverage, international focus, and favorite shows.

themes.name: Developer support and updates
themes.description: Reviews about developer responsiveness, feedback links, update frequency, and update-related regressions.
